description: This file defines the Order controller class for the OpenCart admin sale module. It handles various order-related functionalities including listing, viewing, creating invoices, shipping, order history, and performing actions like delete, add rewards, commissions, and API calls. The class interacts with models, views, and other components to manage order data and operations within the administrative backend.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: OpenCart admin controller class for managing sale orders, providing functions for listing, viewing, editing, and performing actions on orders.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the order list page, setting up data and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to return the order list partial.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the order list HTML view, applying filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific order, including customer, products, totals, and status.

methods.name: call
methods.description: APIs to call the storefront API for a specific order, returning a JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected orders after permission check.

methods.name: invoice
methods.description: Generates an invoice view for selected or specific order(s).

methods.name: shipping
methods.description: Generates shipping details view for selected or specific order(s).

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Fetches and renders the order history with pagination.

methods.name: createInvoiceNo
methods.description: Creates and assigns an invoice number to an order.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds reward points to the customer for the order.

methods.name: removeReward
methods.description: Removes reward points linked to the order.

methods.name: addCommission
methods.description: Adds commission transaction for the affiliate related to the order.

methods.name: removeCommission
methods.description: Removes commission transactions for order's affiliate.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete data for order search inputs.
